thread:
maya: Quick sync — we need to frame the acceptance criteria for the next production cut. Focus: SLA thresholds, docs readiness, support rota, monitoring, and pricing guardrails. Who can own each?

samir: I can own the rollout gating + engineering acceptance tests. Need clarity on perf targets (p50/p95).

kevin: From SRE side: p50 <= 60ms for light gen, p95 <= 400ms for steady traffic looks safe on Dedicated. Also need error-rate SLA: <0.5% 5xx over 24h.

maya: Noted. Priya, revenue/billing constraints? We need a pricing backstop for the pilot.

priya: For pilot, suggest a soft floor: commit to per-token price within 15% of current hosted avg. Also require quota limits to avoid surprise bills. I can draft a short policy.

lori: Docs checklist: quickstart, API contract, rollback steps, and an FAQ for common errors. I can take the quickstart + examples. Who will own the API contract final text?

samir: I'll own the API contract text. Will link to the integration test harness.

maya: Great. Monitoring: what do we need for GA signal?

kevin: Minimum monitoring: per-model latency histograms, token throughput, 4xx/5xx rates, user-facing error traces with sample inputs (sanitized), and cost-per-token telemetry per route. Alerting: page on p95 latency breach > 5m or 5xx spike > 0.5% over 10m.

maya: Support: oncall coverage for first 30 days post-GA. Who volunteers for escalation runbook?

samir: Eng oncall will handle infra incidents. I can write the runbook snippets for model fallback and warm cache recovery.

lori: Docs will include an incident checklist and recovery steps.

priya: Finance wants a prelaunch billing smoke: run a simulated burst with quotas to validate metering + billing pipeline. Need an owner for the smoke.

kevin: I'll run the smoke with eng-infra; need a list of routes and realistic token sizes.

maya: Action items I have so far:
- SLAs: kevin to publish SLA table + error budget clause (owner: kevin)
- Rollout gating + tests: samir to provide canary checklist + integration tests (owner: samir)
- Pricing backstop + quota policy: priya to draft (owner: priya)
- Quickstart + API examples: lori + samir (owners: lori, samir)
- Monitoring + alerts: kevin to add dashboards and paging rules (owner: kevin)
- Billing smoke + metering validation: kevin + priya (owners: kevin, priya)

maya: Can everyone confirm ownership and an ETA (ideally within 5 business days)?

samir: Confirmed. ETA: 5 business days for checklist and contract.

kevin: Confirmed. ETA: 4 business days for SLA table and baseline dashboards; alerts in 5 days.

priya: Confirmed. ETA: 3 business days for pricing draft and quota policy.

lori: Confirmed. ETA: 5 business days for quickstart + FAQ.

maya: Cool. One last thing — rollback/backout criteria for GA: if p95 > 600ms for >15m in canary or 5xx > 1% in production, immediate backout. Agree?

kevin: Agree. Add automatic fallback to smaller model variant if latency breach persists while rollback in progress.

samir: We'll add automated validation in canary pipeline: smoke-gen + a few heavy prompts.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment scheduled: canary-2026-05-12T09:00Z -> 10% traffic. Logs available at https://deploys.redwood/canary/1719954321

maya: Perfect. I'll consolidate this thread into the launch readiness checklist and share a short doc. Thanks team :thumbsup:

lori: will add a link to the doc when ready.

priya: tagging finance slack when draft is up.

kevin: putting alerts into pager duty.

maya: Closing the thread — followups in the doc.
